scientific_limitations: Exact only for the two-subset Johnson graph J(n,2) with n>=3; the equality criterion does not enumerate all maximum sequences; no claims about standard zero forcing or higher Johnson graphs. Unindexed priority risk and limited access to one pertinent Kneser source remain.
title: Grundy total domination of triangular graphs: an exact parity law and extremal-sequence criterion
